d: A muscular, mature build wearing a suit of segmented steel armor in shades of charcoal grey and silver, featuring a breastplate and matching greaves. The outfit includes a purple waist-cloth with gold circular patterns, a brown leather belt with a silver buckle, and a chainmail skirt. A full-face steel helmet with a narrow eye-slit covers the head, and the feet are bare with dark metallic shackles around the ankles. The figure carries a massive, notched blue steel greatsword and a small circular blue shield.
